units.source_text: 一间形似正殿的屋子的西端，有许多侍女住着。

en.t: Many ladies-in-waiting lived in the western end of a building shaped like the main hall.

units.source_text: 惟光听见有几个侍女的声音很熟悉，便清一清嗓子，一本正经地传达源氏公子的诗句。

en.t: Hearing several ladies-in-waiting whose voices sounded familiar, Koremitsu cleared his throat and solemnly delivered Prince Genji's poem.

units.source_text: 青年侍女甚多，她们似乎不明白赠诗者为谁。

en.t: There were many young ladies-in-waiting, and they seemed not to understand who had sent the poem.
Then a reply poem was heard:
